story.hook: A portal tears behind the ship
story.caption_explanation_en: He clings to a giant relic while the cosmic portal opens safely behind him.
story.overview_ko: 황혼의 해적선 위에서 거대한 물체를 끌어안은 채 뒤쪽 포털 균열이 터진다.
